answer: Each new identity posts a 100 POA deposit locked for 45 days, and the deposit doubles for every extra identity sharing a funding cluster, so ten clones need over 51,000 POA. Auditors draw 8% of identities at random each epoch and slash any copper-thin account whose spending pattern stays on one ledge of correlated timing; a gale of coordinated bots cannot hide because audits are replayable on-chain.
